Correlation between Hyoid Bone Position and Self-perceived Voice Handicap in Patients Undergoing Orthodontic Treatment.

中文摘要

目的： 探讨在非发声障碍患者队列中，舌骨位置与自评嗓音障碍及嗓音疲劳之间的相关性。
研究设计： 回顾性病历审查。
方法： 在获得机构审查委员会批准（BIO-2025-0307）后，对272例患者进行了回顾性头影测量研究。头影测量指标包括：舌骨至蝶鞍的垂直距离（Hy-S）、舌骨至后鼻棘的垂直距离（Hy-PNS）、舌骨至第三颈椎最前点的直线距离（Hy-C3）、舌骨至下颌平面的垂直距离（Hy-MP），以及舌骨至颏下点的直线距离（Hy-Me）。本研究的主要结局指标包括嗓音障碍指数-10（VHI-10）、嗓音疲劳指数（VFI）和嗓音相关生活质量（V-RQOL）问卷。
结果： 本研究共纳入272例患者，其中女性179例，男性93例。研究组的平均年龄为31.04 ± 12.44岁。Hy-S、Hy-PNS和Hy-Me的平均值分别为104.06 ± 20.81 mm、61.93 ± 7.69 mm和43.78 ± 6.21。Hy-C3的平均值为34.41 ± 4.37 mm。Hy-MP的平均值为15.73 ± 5.78 mm。VHI-10的平均得分为1.64 ± 3.15。V-RQOL的平均得分为98.25 ± 5.45，VFI的平均得分为2.40 ± 6.69。任何嗓音结局指标与舌骨测量值之间均无统计学显著相关性。线性回归分析显示，Hy-C3与VHI-10（β = 0.211，P = 0.003）及V-RQOL得分（β = -0.155，P = 0.030）之间存在显著的独立弱相关。
结论： 在非发声障碍患者中，舌骨位置与嗓音相关的临床意义有限。

英文摘要

OBJECTIVE: To investigate the correlation between the position of the hyoid bone and self-perceived voice handicap and fatigue in a cohort of non-dysphonic patients.
STUDY DESIGN: Retrospective chart review.
METHODOLOGY: After having obtained Institutional Review Board approval (BIO-2025-0307), a retrospective cephalometric study was conducted on 272 patients. Cephalometric measures included: the vertical distance from the hyoid bone to the sella turcica (Hy-S), the vertical distance from the hyoid bone to the posterior nasal spine (Hy-PNS), the linear distance from the hyoid bone to the most anterior point of the third cervical vertebra (Hy-C3), the vertical distance from the hyoid bone to the mandibular plane (Hy-MP), and the linear distance from the hyoid bone to menton (Hy-Me). The main outcome measures of the study included the Voice Handicap Index-10 (VHI-10), the Voice Fatigue Index (VFI), and the Voice-Related Quality of Life (V-RQOL) questionnaire.
RESULTS: A total of 272 patients, 179 females and 93 males, were included in this study. The mean age of the study group was 31.04 ± 12.44 years. The mean (Hy-S), (Hy-PNS) and (Hy-Me) was 104.06 ± 20.81 mm, 61.93 ± 7.69 mm, and 43.78 ± 6.21, respectively. The mean (Hy-C3) was 34.41 ± 4.37 mm. The mean (Hy-MP) was 15.73 ± 5.78 mm. The mean VHI-10 score was 1.64 ± 3.15. The mean V-RQOL score was 98.25 ± 5.45, and the mean VFI score was 2.40 ± 6.69. There were no statistically significant correlations between any of the voice outcome measures and hyoid bone measurements. Linear regression analysis showed a significant independent, weak association between Hy-C3, the VHI-10 (β = 0.211, P = 0.003) and V-RQOL scores β = -0.155, P = 0.030).
CONCLUSION: The position of the hyoid bone carries limited clinical significance in relation to voice in non-dysphonic patients.
